warning_texts: gate_release_document caveats_rendered.CLM-NET-REVENUE on release/report.md recorded PASS ('present') although the item for that claim lacks 'net of refunds'. The rule looks only for the phrase anywhere in the file, and audit/check_plan.json lists caveats_rendered and claims_rendered under accepted_

The only thing checking that caveats sit on each claim's own item in report.md is this auditor's judgement. check_plan.json has no card-local caveat rule, and release_surface_contract.json has an empty card_caveat_requirements list.

The report period (2025-01-01..2025-03-30) appears only in the report.md H1 title and in dashboard_data.json $.period at the root, never on individual items or cards. The contract's own boundary caveat is on each card, but a reader who copies a single card loses the dates.

In release/report.md the three country figures (lines 15, 17, 19) carry no currency unit: neither the section heading 'Net revenue by country' nor the items say EUR. The dashboard labels do say '(EUR)'.

The spec's period ends 2025-03-30, not 2025-03-31. The report calls this span 'Delivered orders 2025-01-01..2025-03-30' and never says 'Q1', which is consistent. The metrics registry, however, names the period '2025-Q1-delivered', and a quarter label on this span would silently omit 31 March.
summary: All 21 rendered numbers across report.md, dashboard_data.json and the manifest match the metrics registry at their display_digits, and the spec identities hold (countries sum to 35741.52; 27/57 = 0.473684; 201 = 174 + 26 + 1). The release still fails: in report.md the headline CLM-NET-REVENUE item drops its 'net of refunds' caveat, which now appears only in the closing sentence at line 22, and gate_release_document's caveats_rendered passed it anyway by matching that later line.
